text:
Nora B: Need a compact design bundle for the upcoming webinar + inbound push. Deliverables: hero slide (deck + social crop), 3 square microtiles (throughput, latency tail, unit cost), and a one-card benchmark summary (anonymized). Keep it lightweight and email-friendly. Deadline: Monday 11am PT.

Ethan V: Can we keep the aesthetic different from the large benchmark set? Something minimal, white space-forward. Any required copy yet?

Nora B: Short copy only. Headline: 'Serve smarter — cut unit cost, keep quality.' Tile labels: Throughput, Tail latency, Unit TCO. Social caption variants will be added later.

PixelTeam: Thumbsup. Requesting sizes: hero 1200x628 (also GIF 3s loop), tiles 1080x1080, bench 1280x720. Confirm export formats (SVG masters + PNG/JPG).

BrandBot: accessibility note: primary blue #1572E6 low contrast on 12px captions. Use #0D3F99 for small text or bump to 14px. Include ALT text and 8px logo padding. Provide a color-blind safe palette alternative.

Nora B: Use #0D3F99 for captions. We'll localize to ES/FR/JP after first pass. No customer names or precise guarantees 0012.

PixelTeam: We'll mock two visual directions for the hero: A) linear flow showing request -> cache/batch -> result, B) split bars comparing on-host vs serving. GIF will be direction A. Deliver SVG and PNG exports, accessibility variant, and a short README with filenames. ETA: Sun EOD for first pass.

Ethan V: I'll upload anonymized numbers and a 1-paragraph methodology note to the campaign folder now. Use phrasing like "~35% unit cost reduction" and avoid absolute claims.

Maya (Legal): quick reminder: add trademark footer on the benchmark card and avoid implying guaranteed metrics. Wording "up to" or approximate signs are fine. Also confirm no competitor logos.

Nora B: confirmed on TM footer and no logos.

BrandBot: quick checklist: 1) AA contrast for body text, 2) ALT text for each export, 3) color-blind palette included, 4) TM footer on bench slide, 5) 8px logo padding.

PixelTeam: Noted. We'll tag frames HERO_FLOW, HERO_BARS, TILE_THROUGHPUT, TILE_LATENCY, TILE_TCO, BENCH_SUMMARY, README. I'll ping here when the figma first pass is ready for review.

Nora B: thanks 1; please tag me with "Ready for review" in figma comments.
